slides.headline: YOU'RE PAYING FOR THESE 6 BUSINESS DOCUMENTS. AI WRITES ALL OF THEM FOR FREE TONIGHT.
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei waist-up in tailor's apron, touching one of six suited dress forms, symbol tags, calm authority, eyes to camera. Bright navy atelier, glowing Anthropic logo, warm amber light. Documentary 35mm, clear amber-navy contrast.

slides.headline: 1) GET A NEGOTIATION SCRIPT FOR YOUR NEXT VENDOR CALL
slides.body:
Most contracts have 3 to 5 soft clauses ready to be challenged. The vendor will never point them out.

"Find every clause I can challenge. List the 3 strongest points and my opening sentence."

slides.headline: 2) WRITE YOUR WHOLE STAFF ONBOARDING GUIDE TONIGHT
slides.body:
Most new hires leave before the 90-day mark because no written plan exists.

"Build a 30-day onboarding plan: week 1 essentials, 3 key meetings, and 5 tasks to own by day 30."

slides.headline: 3) TURN YOUR INBOX INTO A DONE-FOR-YOU FAQ PAGE
slides.body:
You answer the same customer questions every week. Every one belongs on a page that answers for you.

"Turn my most common questions into a FAQ page with plain-language answers and 5 category headings."

slides.headline: 17% CHEAPER. 50% MORE CAPACITY. THIS WEEK.
slides.body: Anthropic cut rates 17%. OpenAI reset usage limits, the same plan now lasts up to 50% longer. Here are the last 3

slides.headline: 4) BUILD A DECISION TREE YOUR TEAM FOLLOWS WITHOUT YOU
slides.body:
Every business has 5 problems that repeat every week. Without a written guide, your team comes to you every time.

That is not a people problem. That is a missing document.

slides.headline: 5) SCORE ANY PARTNERSHIP BEFORE YOU SIGN ANYTHING
slides.body:
You have probably turned down a deal because something felt off but you could not name what it was.

This prompt names it in writing before your gut gets overruled.

slides.headline: 6) WRITE YOUR BUSINESS CONTINUITY PLAN IN ONE SESSION
slides.body:
Your business depends on you. That is its biggest weakness.

Most owners have no written plan for when:
• they get sick
• a supplier fails
• their best person quits

pinned_comment: Which one is your business most missing right now? For most owners it comes down to slide 2 (the vendor script, fastest money back) or slide 8 (the continuity plan nobody writes until it is already too late).

hook_tournament.why: "Until TOO LATE" hits like a gut punch — it's not just info, it's a warning that you're already behind. [0] sounds like every other business tip account, and [2] is interesting but doesn't make me feel the stakes like [1] does.

hook_sharpen.why: [2] hits you with a direct accusation ('YOU'RE PAYING') and hands you the complete story instantly plus urgency ('TONIGHT'), so you stop scrolling because you already believe it and want to act. [3] makes the same point but reads neutral and passive—no personal hook, no deadline—so you'd swipe through it without the gut-punch that makes you actually stop.
